scope: BASE stand/recovery backend long-training preparation only

dataset_contract.contract_boundary: physical root/joint reset only; previous_action and gait_phase are not restored because IsaacLab resets manager buffers after reset events

injection_point.behavior: append-only final override for selected environments; fraction=0 is an exact no-op

experiments.name: dataset_and_pure_event_contract
experiments.hypothesis: Stage335 data has an immutable, finite, name-safe physical reset contract
experiments.intervention: strict key/shape/hash/range validation plus name-based joint reorder
experiments.control: wrong SHA and mismatched joint names must abort
experiments.result: passed; 6 focused tests total including the existing gravity roundtrip test
experiments.conclusion: dataset and pure reset transformation are ready

experiments.name: zero_update_isaaclab_reset_smoke
experiments.hypothesis: official-MuJoCo states can initialize the IsaacLab stand substrate without any policy update
experiments.intervention: 16 environments, recovery fraction 1.0, balanced 8 pass/8 fail states
experiments.control: inherited reset terms execute first; the appended event is the only override
experiments.conclusion: physical injection is executable and exact at reset

experiments.name: one_update_runner_ab
experiments.hypothesis: the recovery event is compatible with the existing stand checkpoint and PPO runner
experiments.result: both branches completed and wrote isolated model_151 checkpoints
experiments.conclusion: runner compatibility is proven; one update is not performance evidence, and 50% is too aggressive to pre-authorize for long training

tests.command: PYTHONPATH=tools conda run -n x2-sonic-isaaclab python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_recovery_reset_curriculum.py tests/test_stop_recovery_states.py

long_training_gate.reason: the reset interface is ready, but no multi-seed short panel has yet shown that a low recovery fraction improves recovery without degrading nominal stand
long_training_gate.next_minimal_experiment: same-seed 0/0.05/0.10 recovery-fraction panel for at most 5 updates, followed by frozen official-MuJoCo stand-stop evaluation; do not start a long run from either smoke checkpoint
